{{Top|leg}}
'''Bantha-topato stew''' was a [[Stew/Legends|stew]] made with [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] meat and [[Topato/Legends|topato]]. In [[44 ABY]], bantha-topato stew was served aboard the ''[[Concussor]]'' by a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Unidentified cook (Concussor)|cook]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
